The Windows 10 display settings allow you to change the appearance of your desktop and customize it to your liking. There are many different display settings you can adjust, from adjusting the brightness of your screen to choosing the size of text and icons on your monitor. Here is a step-by-step guide on how to adjust your Windows 10 display settings.

1. Find the Start button located at the bottom left corner of your screen. Click on the Start button and then select Settings.

2. In the Settings window, click on System.

3. On the left side of the window, click on Display. This will open up the display settings options.

4. You can adjust the brightness of your screen by using the slider located at the top of the page. You can also change the scaling of your screen by selecting one of the preset sizes or manually adjusting the slider.

5. To adjust the size of text and icons on your monitor, scroll down to the Scale and layout section. Here you can choose between the recommended size and manually entering a custom size. Once you have chosen the size you would like, click the Apply button to save your changes.

6. You can also adjust the orientation of your display by clicking the dropdown menu located under Orientation. You have the options to choose between landscape, portrait, and rotated.

7. Next, scroll down to the Multiple displays section. Here you can choose to extend your display or duplicate it onto another monitor.

8. Finally, scroll down to the Advanced display settings section. Here you can find more advanced display settings such as resolution and color depth.

By making these adjustments to your Windows 10 display settings, you can customize your desktop to fit your personal preference. Additionally, these settings can help improve the clarity of your monitor for a better viewing experience.

entry.content:
Latest JammText Update Released: Version 1.3 with Enhanced Capabilities

JammText is the premier interactive text-to-screen software for DJs — version 1.3 introduces a few new highly-requested features.

VIEW LARGER IMAGE

Mixcity Inc, announced yesterday a new version 1.3 release of their JammText software for DJs and karaoke hosts. Included in the free update for JammText customers is 64bit support that improves system-wide performance and support for the latest macOS Mojave. A widely requested addition is the ability for patrons to email pictures or messages to screen (as opposed to only text-to-screen support).

MixCity Inc also announced that another highly sought after feature is well under way and should be released soon. Read the message below from Mixcity Inc for further details.

JammText allows DJs to interact with their audience while boosting your marketing and revenue potential. You can learn more about JammText and download a free trial HERE .

Disclaimer: This post includes affiliate links

If you click on a link and make a purchase, I may receive a commission at no extra cost to you.

Email to screen

We are excited to announce that we have added a new email to screen function in JammText 1.3. Your audience will now have the option of emailing a picture or message to the screen.

Scan to screen

With the new email to screen feature we have also added an auto generated QR code. This QR code is randomly displayed on your screen instructing the audience to scan code to post pictures or messages to this screen. When the QR code is scanned it automatically opens the audience members email app with a composed email addressed to post on the JammText screen.

64 bit and Mojave Support

JammText is now 64 bit for Mac which improves its performance. Also, JammText is supported for the new macOS Mojave.

Voting coming soon

We are in the final stages of completing the highly requested Voting feature and will be releasing this update in the near future. Look out for that announcement coming soon.

Instagram discontinued

Facebook has decided to make changes to their Instagram platform. These changes went into effect today, December 11, 2018. Instagram will no longer allow third-party apps to search for pictures via a hashtag. JammText is one of the third-party apps that has been negatively effected by this decision. Mixcity Inc. has no choice but to discontinue the use of Instagram in JammText. This decision only affects the use of Instagram in JammText. Every other part of JammText will continue to work as it always has. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause to you or any of our customer base. We encourage you to continue using JammText text-to-screen, Tweet-to-screen and the addition of email-to-screen to engage and interact with your audience!
Upgrade today for free to get the best version of JammText to date!

The original Denon DN-MC6000 has long been a very popular DJ controller with DEX 3 users (myself included), especially mobile DJs due to it’s fairly compact size, 19″ rackmount supportand easy navigation. The MC6000Mk2 is Denon DJ’s next generation, flagship professional DJ controller and digital mixer. Created to be the definitive tool for the most discerning of contemporary club and mobile DJ’s, the slimline, table-top steel chassis unit blends a 4 channel/8 source real-time matrix operational digital mixer with an uncompromising 24-bit, class leading digital and analog audio interface.

The Windows 10 display settings allow you to change the appearance of your desktop and customize it to your liking. There are many different display settings you can adjust, from adjusting the brightness of your screen to choosing the size of text and icons on your monitor. Here is a step-by-step guide on how to adjust your Windows 10 display settings.

1. Find the Start button located at the bottom left corner of your screen. Click on the Start button and then select Settings.

2. In the Settings window, click on System.

3. On the left side of the window, click on Display. This will open up the display settings options.

4. You can adjust the brightness of your screen by using the slider located at the top of the page. You can also change the scaling of your screen by selecting one of the preset sizes or manually adjusting the slider.

5. To adjust the size of text and icons on your monitor, scroll down to the Scale and layout section. Here you can choose between the recommended size and manually entering a custom size. Once you have chosen the size you would like, click the Apply button to save your changes.

6. You can also adjust the orientation of your display by clicking the dropdown menu located under Orientation. You have the options to choose between landscape, portrait, and rotated.

7. Next, scroll down to the Multiple displays section. Here you can choose to extend your display or duplicate it onto another monitor.

8. Finally, scroll down to the Advanced display settings section. Here you can find more advanced display settings such as resolution and color depth.

By making these adjustments to your Windows 10 display settings, you can customize your desktop to fit your personal preference. Additionally, these settings can help improve the clarity of your monitor for a better viewing experience.
